raw_text: Sri Lanka is back to square one. My relatives in Colombo say fuel queues are 3-4 hours long again. The IMF bailout conditions are killing ordinary people. Tax on essential goods up 40%. Today's protest near Presidential Secretariat has tens of thousands. The government learned nothing from 2022.
clean_text: Fuel queues 3-4 hours in Colombo. IMF conditions raising taxes 40% on essentials. Tens of thousands protesting near Presidential Secretariat.
